summary.name: FreeCAD
summary.one_liner: FreeCAD is an open-source parametric 3D modeler for designing real-life objects of any size.
summary.what_it_does: FreeCAD lets you sketch geometry-constrained 2D shapes and use them as a base for 3D objects, and change designs later by editing parameters in the model history. It can extract design details from 3D models to create production-ready drawings. It reads and writes open file formats such as STEP, IGES, STL, SVG, DXF, OBJ, IFC and DAE. Its workbenches cover finite element analysis, experimental CFD, BIM, geodata, CAM/CNC and robot simulation.
notable: Parametric modeling with editable model history
Open file format support including STEP, IGES, STL, DXF, IFC
Modular workbenches including FEA, BIM, CAM/CNC and robot simulation
caveats: CFD workbench is described as experimental
Page does not give a specific version or detail on platform limits beyond Windows, Mac and Linux
